provenance.source: Luxury Maritime Concierge CRM (Luxury Maritime Reference Platform)

principles.empiricalProofInvariant: Claims require fresh terminal execution proof or off-screen framebuffer screenshots
principles.antiMockInvariant: Zero mock leakage; real delivery destinations and verified live endpoints

fourPillars.invariant: Filesystem depth <= 3 across 00_INBOX, 10_ACTIVE_TIMEBOUND, 20_ACTIVE_CONTINUOUS, 30_REFERENCE, 40_ARCHIVE. Zero files on Desktop.
100% bidirectional traceability link graph: BPMN (L3) -> Use Case (L5) -> Slices -> Tests -> Code.
Pydantic schema validation, strict data contracts, and zero mock leakage in production paths.
All use cases explicitly define Basic Flow (F1), Alternate Flows (Flow Alt), and Exception Loops (Flow Exc) with zero dead-ends.

checks: Primary Actor & Canonical Role Alignment
Level 1 User Goal Compliance (Active Verb Phrase)
Vertical Slices Completeness (Presentation -> DB without horizontal dead-ends)
FSM State Transitions Monotonicity
Reversibility Rule (Zero logical dead-ends, 1-tap undo)
Separation of Duties (Requester != Approver)
Business Rules Engine (R1 Cost Gate >5M, R2 Margin Gate <30%, R8 50% Deposit Gate, R12 Engine Hours Watchdog)
Layer 0 Meso Laws (Hick's Law: 1 primary CTA, Miller's Law: <=7 groups, Rule of 6)
Layer 0 Micro Laws (8pt grid tokens, touch targets >= 44x44px, Fitts's Law)
Spatial Layout Primitives (Stack, Cluster, Split, Grid, Subgrid, Frame)
Luxury Aesthetic Tokens (Linen Canvas #F4F2ED, Card #FFFEFB, Bronze Gold #8A6D3B, Navy #17212C)
End-to-end verified delivery (zero mock fallbacks)
Live headless browser execution proof (Playwright, zero window popping)
Latency Budgets (API calls > 400ms mandate skeleton shimmer)
Legal Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA >= 4.5:1 optical contrast)
Data Privacy (Decree 13 / GDPR PII masking via FLS VIP Shield)
Boundary robustness (negative value rejects, hull ISO format checks)
Exception recovery loops (Flow Exc)
Business Model Canvas (BMC) alignment & margin defense
Deterministic EBQC Quality Gate pass (EAI >= 0.980)

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Primary Actor & Authority Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Verifies canonical persona, credentials, and RBAC authorization role

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Level 1 Goal & Active Verb Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Validates active verb-phrase user goal and complete actor intention

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Preconditions & Trigger State Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Asserts environmental trigger, antecedent case state, and preconditions

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Success Guarantee (Postcondition) Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Verifies postconditions, atomic commits, and outward deliverables

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Minimum Guarantee & Safety Lock Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Validates atomic error rollback, safety locks, and immutable state defense

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Basic Flow F1 Sequential Execution Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Verifies end-to-end main success scenario actor-system step interaction

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Alternate Flow (Flow Alt) Branching Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Validates variant success paths, fast paths, and state convergence

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Exception Loop (Flow Exc) Rework Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Checks validation aborts, rework loops, and zero dead-end recovery

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Vertical Slices Completeness Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Asserts thin vertical end-to-end threads cutting Presentation -> DB

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Field-Level Security (FLS) & Shield Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Enforces IYTC VIP Data Shield and Decree 13 PII masking invariants

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Status-Action & Button Governance Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Validates dynamic active/disabled/hidden button states across FSM

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Business Rules Engine (R1..R12) Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Asserts strict enforcement of financial, margin, and milestone rules

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Separation of Duties (SoD) Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Enforces 2-node separation (requester != approver, surveyor != signoff)

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Database Schema & Entity Integrity Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Validates SQLite/PostgreSQL entity mapping, foreign keys, and audit log

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Playwright End-User Interaction Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Asserts realistic typing, clicking, form submission, and toast validation

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Video Stream EBML & Codec Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Checks VP8/Matroska container headers, 1366x768 resolution, and timing

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: Video Size & Non-Trivial Threshold Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Guarantees physical artifact file size strictly exceeds 50,000 bytes

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: UTOP Upstream Traceability Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Traces BPMN (L3) -> Use Case (L5) -> Slices -> Tests -> Code

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: MECE Zone & Zero-Desktop Invariant Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Asserts physical placement in evidence/videos/ with folder depth <= 3

reviewAgentTaxonomy.title: EBQC Quality Gate & Certification Auditor
reviewAgentTaxonomy.focus: Verifies Evidence Alignment Index (EAI >= 0.980) and zero defect sign-off
